title: Baleful
summary: BA'LEFUL, adjective [See Bale.] Woeful; sad; sorrowful; full of grief; producing misery; as, a baleful smart; baleful eyes. 2. Mischievous; destructive; pernicious; calamitous; deadly; as, baleful ene

inlines.v: BA'LEFUL, adjective [See Bale.] Woeful; sad; sorrowful; full of grief; producing misery; as, a baleful smart; baleful eyes. 2. Mischievous; destructive; pernicious; calamitous; deadly; as, baleful enemies; baleful war.
